title: Brand voices
description: How your brand sounds: tone, rules and examples the AI follows, plus your own styles.

voices.title: Brand voices
voices.emptyHint: Define how your brand sounds. The AI then writes in that voice.

editor.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change brand voices.
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: What does the brand stand for, and whom does it address?
editor.toneHint: Up to 10 terms, for example friendly or competent.
editor.dosHint: What the texts should do. One point per line.
editor.dontsHint: What the texts should avoid. One point per line.
editor.vocabularyHint: Terms the brand likes to use.
editor.forbiddenWordsHint: The AI avoids them, and the composer flags them.
editor.examplesHint: 3 to 5 typical posts of the brand. The AI takes over tone and rhythm, not the content.

test.title: Test the voice
test.description: The AI writes a sample post with the saved version.
test.briefPlaceholder: Without a topic the AI picks a general one.
test.saveFirst: Save your changes to test them.
test.archived: Archived brand voices cannot be tested.

versions.title: Version history
versions.description: Every change of the content creates a new version. Generated posts remember their version.
versions.examples: {count, plural, =0 {No example posts} one {One example post} other {# example posts}}

styles.title: Custom styles
styles.description: Add to the presets in the composer, in the same order. Inactive styles do not appear there.
styles.emptyHint: A custom style describes in your own words how a post should sound and be structured.
styles.name: Name
styles.instructionsHint: How should a post in this style sound, and how should it be structured?
styles.dragHint: Drag to sort, or move with the arrows.
